profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer – Chip Serialization Infrastructure at Cisco Systems Inc.
profile.summary:
More than twenty years of professional software development experience 
 Software development life cycle (designing, coding, testing, deploying, support) 
 Web-based, Oracle-based, RDBMS, distributed client-server and n-tier systems 
 Programming in Java, C/C++, PL/SQL, Oracle, MySQL, Windows, Unix, Linux 
 J2EE, Servlets, JSP, Spring Framework, Hibernate, Ajax, SOAP, JNI, EJB, JDBC 
 Stored Procedure, Pro*C, Python, Perl, Shell scripts, JavaScript, XML, HTML, UML 
 Eclipse, NetBeans, Microsoft Visual Studio, CVS, Git, Ant, Apache, Tomcat, Struts 
 Hands-on technical skills, creative, self-motivated, leadership

positions.title: Principle Software Engineer – Chip Serialization Infrastructure
positions.description:
Develop Black-box systems including secure key request clients and key servers, 
Key Generation Center, and Secure Data Distribution systems to provide solutions and 
supports  for  several  chip  vendors  and  chip  manufactures  in  mass  production  that 
successfully serialized more than 400 million DTV set-top box chips worldwide 
Design and write codes in Java, C/C++, Pro*C, MySQL on Windows and Linux

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer – Telecommunication Services
positions.description:
Developed Web-based customizable solutions and services include full billing and 
resale capabilities, call accounting, asset management, data  and Wi-Fi billing, work 
order, service request, switch integration, cable management and inventory to allow 
enterprise organizations centrally managing data from varying sources and formats 
from one intuitive system 
 Designed and wrote codes in Java, C/C++, PL/SQL, Oracle, Windows and Linux

positions.title: Staff Engineer – Systems Integration
positions.description:
Developed the library to provide a common way for database access from several 
subsystems of the Ultra-High Throughput Screening System to automate screening 
process with very large volume of samples for extremely speeding up drug discovery 
Designed and coded in Java, C/C++, Pro*C, PL/SQL, Oracle, Windows and Unix

positions.title: Software Engineer – IT Services
positions.description:
Developed numerous service distributed systems for banking and retailing solutions 
included E-Service system, Customer Relationship Management system, Customer 
Care  Link,  Customer  Service  Management  system,  Technical  Action  Request  and 
Problem Solving System, Enterprise Data Warehouse 
Designed and wrote codes in Java, C/C++, Pro*C, PL/SQL, Oracle, Teradata, Unix
